name: calculate_bonus
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sample.calculate_bonus(p_salary numeric, p_rate numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    select p_salary * p_rate;
$function$

name: calculate_bonus
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sample.calculate_bonus(p_salary numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    select sample.calculate_bonus(p_salary, 0.1);
$function$

arguments: IN p_employee_id integer, IN p_amount numeric
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sample.raise_salary(IN p_employee_id integer, IN p_amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
begin
    update sample.employee set salary = salary + p_amount where employee_id = p_employee_id;
end;
$procedure$
